name: APT Electronics Co Ltd
summary: APT Electronics Co., Ltd., established in Guangzhou in 2003, makes advanced vision products and system solutions. Its automotive range includes smart headlamps, rear lamps and interior lighting for smart, electric and combustion vehicles, along with automotive-grade LED components and modules. It also produces mini backlights, general lighting LEDs, infrared, UV and RGB LEDs, display backlight modules and horticultural lighting.
